fields.label: Rollout and Safety Controls
fields.description: Start fail-closed: enable the engine only after workers are healthy, and enable external actions only after provider verification.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Global workflow execution switch. When disabled, authoring and simulation remain available but no event, timer, schedule, backfill, or token is executed.

fields.label: External Actions Enabled
fields.description: Independent kill switch for email, SMS, and webhook effects. Keep disabled until each provider is configured and verified through a controlled UAT workflow.

fields.label: AI Workflow Actions Enabled
fields.description: Independent kill switch for AI provider calls. AI authoring and deterministic simulation remain available while disabled.

fields.label: AI Workflow Authoring Enabled
fields.description: Allow workflow builders to request billable AI-generated draft workflows. Generated drafts are validated and require explicit review and application; they are never published automatically.

fields.label: AI Workflow Authoring Agent (deprecated)
fields.description: Deprecated. Superseded by the Generator and Editor agents below, which are the ones actually used. Kept only so older sites keep working; safe to clear once a Generator agent is set.

fields.label: AI Workflow Generator Agent
fields.description: Text AI Agent that builds a full workflow draft from a plain-language request. Its Messages table holds the prompt (with {placeholder} variables) and its Structured Output holds the draft schema; nothing is hardcoded in code.

fields.label: AI Workflow Editor Agent
fields.description: Text AI Agent used for incremental edits to an existing draft. Falls back to the generator agent when unset.

fields.label: AI Authoring Output Tokens
fields.description: Maximum output for one workflow draft proposal. Runtime range: 1024 to 8192 tokens.

fields.label: AI Authoring Requests per Day
fields.description: Site-wide UTC-day cap for billable workflow draft requests. Runtime range: 1 to 5000.

fields.label: Blocked DocTypes
fields.description: Additional exact DocType names that workflows must never read, enroll, or modify, one per line. Built-in framework and automation-internal DocTypes are always blocked.

fields.label: AI Safety and Budgets
fields.description: Hard server-side limits applied to every AI workflow action, including tests.

fields.label: Maximum AI Context Characters
fields.description: Maximum redacted record, conversation, and knowledge text supplied to one AI action. Range: 5000 to 200000.

fields.label: Maximum Thread Messages
fields.description: Maximum recent linked Communications included in one support action. Range: 1 to 50.

fields.label: Maximum AI Output Tokens
fields.description: Site-wide upper bound for a workflow AI response. Range: 128 to 8192.

fields.label: Default AI Timeout (Seconds)
fields.description: Provider timeout when a node does not select a lower value. Range: 10 to 300 seconds.

fields.label: Daily AI Token Budget
fields.description: Maximum recorded input plus output tokens per UTC day. New attempts fail closed after the budget is reached.

fields.label: Maximum AI Provider Retries
fields.description: Bounded retries handled by the provider client for transient failures. Runtime clamps this value between 0 and 3.

fields.label: AI Circuit Failure Threshold
fields.description: Pause calls to one provider/model after this many consecutive recorded failures. Runtime range: 2 to 20.

fields.label: AI Circuit Cooldown (Minutes)
fields.description: How long a failed provider/model circuit remains open before one new call may test recovery. Runtime range: 1 to 120 minutes.

fields.label: AI Test Requests per User / 10 Minutes
fields.description: Per-user rate limit for explicitly billable Test AI calls. Runtime range: 1 to 100.

fields.label: AI Evidence Retention (Days)
fields.description: Completed AI attempt evidence older than this is deleted by workflow log cleanup. Minimum 30 days; workflow run retention may keep linked evidence longer.

fields.label: Throughput and Execution Limits
fields.description: Bounded dispatcher batch sizes protect workers and the database. Increase gradually after observing UAT queue latency and database load.

fields.label: Outbox Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum durable outbox events claimed by one dispatcher pass. Larger values reduce backlog faster but hold more database locks.

fields.label: Token Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum ready workflow tokens queued by one dispatcher pass. Keep aligned with available background-worker capacity.

fields.label: Timer Batch Size
fields.description: Maximum due timers released by one scheduler pass. Increase only when timer lag remains high with healthy workers.

fields.label: Maximum Recursion Depth
fields.description: Maximum nested automation/subflow depth for one causation chain. Further recursion is stopped to prevent workflow loops.
Completed workflow runs and resolved operational logs older than this number of days are removed. Minimum 180 days preserves the client-required six-month history window.
fields.label: Workflow Log Retention (Days)

fields.description: How often the hourly scheduler checks and removes expired workflow logs. Range: 1 to 168 hours.
fields.label: Log Cleanup Interval (Hours)

fields.description: Maximum records removed from each log table in one cleanup pass. Range: 100 to 5000. Increase gradually when old logs accumulate.
fields.label: Log Cleanup Batch Size

fields.description: Last successful scheduled cleanup. This is updated by the scheduler and is not affected by the workflow execution switch.
fields.label: Last Log Cleanup
Health, Incidents, and Alerts
fields.description: Runtime preflight becomes unhealthy for recent failed runs, stale or orphaned active runs, open incidents, open dead letters, queue failures, or excessive queue age.

fields.label: Failed Run Health Window (Hours)
fields.description: A failed run keeps runtime health red for this rolling number of hours. Open incidents and dead letters are evaluated separately. Range enforced by runtime: 1 to 720 hours.

fields.label: Incident Alert User
fields.description: Optional enabled system user notified when a grouped incident reaches the occurrence threshold. Leave empty to record incidents without direct user notifications.

fields.label: Incident Alert Threshold
fields.description: Notify the Incident Alert User when the same incident fingerprint reaches this occurrence count. Use at least 1; the default is 3.

fields.label: Alert Timer Lag Threshold (Minutes)
fields.description: Create an operational incident when an active timer is overdue by at least this many minutes.

fields.label: Alert Queue Age Threshold (Minutes)
fields.description: Mark runtime unhealthy and alert when a ready token, active run, or pending/retrying outbox event is older than this many minutes.
